Hi Elena and Marcus, thanks for joining this check-in. As we work toward closing this case, I need to make sure we have a clear working agreement documented for how information will continue to move between you two each week, since the project still requires that ongoing coordination.

Before we settle on any arrangements, I want to walk through each person's concrete operating constraints and any prior promises that have been made about how weekly information transfers should work. This is part of the formal case-record disclosure step, so that anything that should govern your ongoing work gets recorded accurately in the working agreement.

Elena, could you start by sharing any concrete operating constraints you have, and any prior promises or commitments -- whether you made them or received them -- that relate to how information should be transferred between you and Marcus week to week?
